scope: Retrospective timing audit of the actual single Shed-derived room run; no model, Blender, or GPU execution.

source.method: Read task_started and task_complete/turn_aborted events, corroborate their chronological stages against saved prompt/result/CLI events, and use recorded duration_ms. No filesystem mtime estimates.

codex_stages.duration_basis: Codex rollout terminal-event duration_ms; not subprocess wall time or GPU time.
codex_stages.mapping: Chronological rollout turn order, submitted prompt match, same session ID, and matching failed/interrupted/completed outcomes. The two resume prompts are identical and are distinguished by their ordered terminal outcomes.

totals.semantics: Sum of the four recorded Codex turn durations. Includes agent internal tools and previews; excludes waiting between calls and independent host/relocation rendering. Do not add author preview render durations again.
totals.reason: No direct timed interval for the complete workflow including staging, recovery, independent verification, relocation and primary review was recorded. The long gap between initial failure and recovery is not active generation time.

usage_verification.semantics: Session cumulative; do not sum per-stage usage snapshots. Cached input is already in input_tokens; reasoning output is already in output_tokens. Failed stage segment usage remains unknown (null), not zero.

unknowns: Exact subprocess launch/exit wall times were not recorded by call_llm.py.
Build-phase wall durations are not structured in the retained build reports and are not inferred from file mtimes.
Initial failed and interrupted CLI calls have no segmented usage report; the final whole-session cumulative usage is available.
These durations are not isolated model inference time, GPU time, a billing estimate or cross-run performance statistics.
